action.G01.label: Take the tool bag
action.G01.001: Screwdriver, pliers, multimeter. One shopping run for Gran, and I’m kitted out for a full overhaul.
action.G01.objective: Help Mira with her shopping: stop by the pick-up point at Lúčny koník.
action.G01.journal: Help Mira with her shopping: stop by the pick-up point at Lúčny koník.
action.G02.001: Hi, Ela. Gran says you’ve got an order for her.
action.G02.002: Dana has it ready. Here’s the list and a spare mask. Leave the bag outside for your gran and ring her.
action.G02.003: I know. Gran told me before you did. Twice.
action.G02.004: Then this makes three. And Dana will tell you again before lunch.
action.G02.x01: We have. She rang at seven to ask if it was ready, and at eight to ask if you were up yet.
action.G02.x02: And what did you tell her?
action.G02.x03: That we don’t do wake-up calls. So she booked one with us for six tomorrow.
action.G02.x04: If Gran rings again, tell her I’m on my way.
action.G02.x05: I will. She’s on my list, right after the potatoes.
action.G02.objective: Collect the bag of shopping Dana has ready for you at the shop.
action.G02.journal: Collect the bag of shopping Dana has ready for you at the shop.
action.G03.label: Collect Mira’s shopping
action.G03.001: Hi, Dana. I’ve brought Gran’s list.
action.G03.002: Tea, oats, potatoes. It’s already paid for, Ela sorted it.
action.G03.003: I’ll carry it by both handles. Gran’s rule.
action.G03.004: See, you know it already. I was supposed to remind you, so consider yourself reminded.
action.G03.x01: Hi. I know that list by heart. Mrs Hrušková writes the same thing every week, just with a different pen.
action.G03.x02: So why does she write it at all?
action.G03.x03: So I can see Mrs Hrušková is all right. Her handwriting tells me more than the phone does.
action.G03.x04: You wouldn’t have a bit of spare time back there as well? Gran has planned my whole day.
action.G03.x05: I don’t sell time. Everyone has to save up their own.
action.G03.objective: Leave the shopping on the little table outside Mira’s garden gate.
action.G03.journal: Leave the shopping on the little table outside Mira’s garden gate.
action.G04.label: Put the shopping on the table
action.G04.001: Gran, your shopping’s on the table. I’m stepping back.
action.G04.002: Thank you. Take the side path to the window and ring me. You wouldn’t hear me through the glass.
action.G04.003: Right. The side path and the phone. We haven’t talked this close all month.
action.G04.x01: I can see you. One more step back. There, now it’s exactly two metres.
action.G04.x03: On Monday, before the quarantine. I’m an engineer, not a fortune teller.
action.G04.x04: And I’ve got something else for you. But that’s for the window.
action.G04.objective: Go to the closed window and talk to Mira on the phone.
action.G04.journal: Go to the closed window and talk to Mira on the phone.
action.G05.001: I do. Roman carried some boxes into the garden workshop for me. There’s a device in them called ZVON, and it keeps making sounds even though it’s unplugged.
action.G05.003: If you think so, go and have a look. The key’s in the letterbox outside, by the window. Take it, but don’t come into the house.
action.G05.005: Because the first thing it did was ring out. Like a bell – a zvon. We never came up with anything better.
action.G05.x01: Not into the house, into the workshop. I know Gran’s rules.
action.G05.x02: You’ve forgotten one: listen first, take apart later.
action.G05.x04: Me and Oto Bielik, a mechanic from Ivanka. I’ll tell you more once you stop going on about capacitors.
action.G05.x05: Then I’ll go and get the key. And we’re not finished with that capacitor.
action.G05.objective: Unlock Mira’s garden workshop with the key from the letterbox.
action.G05.journal: Unlock Mira’s garden workshop with the key from the letterbox.
action.G06.label: Unlock the garden workshop
action.G06.001: The key fits and the lock doesn’t even creak. Gran clearly oils it more often than I oil the hinges in my garage.
action.G06.objective: Open the brass case in the workshop porch.
action.G06.journal: Open the brass case in the workshop porch.
action.G07.label: Take the device out of the case
action.G07.001: ZVON, and a sticker saying ‘Sokolíkova 1995’. I know this device from school. Back then we weren’t even allowed to breathe on it.
action.G07.003: I know it, and it knows me. Gran, you should have told me about this, even if I didn’t ask.
action.G07.objective: In the back room of the workshop, inspect the service section of the ZVON device.
action.G07.journal: In the back room of the workshop, inspect the service section of the ZVON device.
action.G08.label: Open the service cover
action.G08.001: First I disconnect the small power supply, then the cover comes off. The fuse is blown, but you can still read the rating.
action.G08.002: I’ve got the same one at home in the garage. So far it’s a perfectly ordinary repair.
action.G08.objective: Take an identical fuse from the drawer in your garage.
action.G08.journal: Take an identical fuse from the drawer in your garage.
action.G09.label: Take a spare fuse
action.G09.001: Same rating, same type. The old one goes in the e-waste box.
action.G09.002: With a device that makes sounds without any power, I’d rather not improvise.
action.G09.objective: In the workshop, put the spare fuse into the cradle of the ZVON base node.
action.G09.journal: In the workshop, put the spare fuse into the cradle of the ZVON base node.
action.G10.label: Insert the spare fuse
action.G10.001: Fuse in, cover closed, power supply connected.
action.G10.003: Circle, triangle, square. Like nursery school, only with pricier building blocks.
action.G10.objective: On the shape panel, connect matching shapes as the diagram above it shows.
action.G10.journal: On the shape panel, connect matching shapes as the diagram above it shows.
action.G11.label: Connect the reference shapes
action.G11.002: 1995 is a year, not a voltage. I hope the thing is just showing the wrong unit.
action.G11.objective: In Bratislava in 1995, find Sokolíkova School and Mira inside it.
action.G11.journal: In Bratislava in 1995, find Sokolíkova School and Mira inside it.
action.C01.label: Show the verified imprint from 1962
action.C01.001: So that was you. I remember that imprint.
action.C01.002: A bridge? And where do I get one?
action.C01.003: Oto built one in 1982, at Sokolíkova. His grandson Tóno helped him.
action.C01.005: He was still at school then. Today he’s fifty and he holds the place together. I’ve rung him to say you’ll be coming for my technical property.
action.C01.006: Then I’ll drop in on him.
action.C01.007: And after that, you and Ela will finish the paperwork for moving my box.
action.C01.k01: And now, seriously. If you want to stop the erasing, you need a return bridge.
action.C01.k02: A physical one, ceramic, not another device. I won’t let you go anywhere without it.
action.C01.x01: Gran, I’m back. In the right year, at least. I need to show you something.
action.C01.x02: Hold it up to the glass. I’ve had my glasses on since this morning, in case you came back.
action.C01.x03: And those shoes. In Ivanka they talked about them until Christmas.
action.C01.x04: You remembered me all those years?
action.C01.x05: The shoes, yes. I’ve only just put a face to them.
action.C01.x06: ‘Technical property.’ Sounds like I’m off to collect a tractor.
action.C01.x07: To the school it’s property. To me it’s a box of things nobody but me knows how to plug in.
action.C01.x08: Anything else, before that device sends me off somewhere again?
action.C01.x09: Yes. Take a photo of the school yard, exactly as it is today.
action.C01.objective: In Dúbravka in 2020, photograph the school yard and report to Tóno, the caretaker.
action.C01.journal: In Dúbravka in 2020, photograph the school yard and report to Tóno, the caretaker.
action.D01.label: Photograph the school yard
action.D01.001: I’ll take the whole corner from the pavement: the tarmac yard and the service window with the swallow. No tree, no low wall.
action.D01.002: The photo stays in the phone’s protected memory, even if the yard changes. I take Gran’s advice literally.
action.D01.objective: Report to Tóno at the caretaker’s service window.
action.D01.journal: Report to Tóno at the caretaker’s service window.
action.D02.label: Show Tóno Mira’s chronometer
action.D02.001: Mrs Hrušková’s device. She said you’d come. My grandad made a bridge for it in 1982, but it got lost over the years.
action.D02.002: Is there at least a drawing of it left?
action.D02.003: Grandad wrote everything down in the service logbook in the prep room. Your permit is ready; Jana will let you in remotely.
action.D02.005: The other classrooms are closed. Today everyone stays where they are. Me, here behind the window.
action.D02.x01: Good morning, Mr Farkaš. I’m Mrs Hrušková’s grandson, and I’m supposed to show you this.
action.D02.x02: Good morning. Hold it up to the glass, please. This year I only open the window for parcels.
action.D02.x03: Remotely? How do you let someone into a prep room remotely?
action.D02.x04: Jana switches on the camera, I unlock the door. She supervises, I’m responsible.
action.D02.x06: All day. Parents ring, I take notes, couriers ring the bell. These days a caretaker is mostly a switchboard operator.
action.D02.objective: In the physics prep room, find Oto’s service record from 1982.
action.D02.journal: In the physics prep room, find Oto’s service record from 1982.
action.D03.label: Read the record and the return bridge diagram
action.D03.001: Seventh of December 1982, entered by Oto Bielik. Note: grandson Anton helped with the preparation.
action.D03.002: That’s our caretaker today. We went to school together. The bridge got lost, but the drawing survived.
action.D03.003: The chronometer reacts to that date. I’ll try it by the old clock at the stop.
action.D03.x01: Good morning. I can see you, just slightly from above. That’s the right book.
action.D03.x02: Oto really did write down everything. I could do with a list like that in my garage.
action.D03.x03: Not a list. A record. You write a list before the work and a record after it.
action.D03.x04: The copy is yours, the original stays in the prep room. That’s what Tóno and I agreed.
action.D03.objective: At the Dúbravka stop in 2020, hold the copy of the record against the frame of the old clock.
action.D03.journal: At the Dúbravka stop in 2020, hold the copy of the record against the frame of the old clock.
action.D04.label: Open the time window to Dúbravka 1982
action.D04.002: Another time window. Three years before I was born, this time.
action.D04.objective: At the time node, choose 1982 and find twelve-year-old Tóno at the same service window.
action.D04.journal: At the time node, choose 1982 and find twelve-year-old Tóno at the same service window.
action.D05.label: Open the service cavity in the low wall
action.D05.001: The lime tree stands here. The low wall stayed under it; the bench has moved. The photo on my phone still shows tarmac.
action.D05.002: Row two, column three. Behind the service board is our jar. Thirty-eight years of dust on the outside, dry paper inside.
action.D05.objective: Open the jar with the tools from your tool bag and show the bridge to Tóno at the service window.
action.D05.journal: Open the jar with the tools from your tool bag and show the bridge to Tóno at the service window.
action.D06.label: Open the jar and clean the contacts
action.D06.001: I’ll loosen the old thread. The ceramic is intact; I’ll clean the contacts and measure them.
action.D06.002: The very same piece. I’ve never waited thirty-eight years and five minutes for a part before.
action.D06.journal: The jar is open, the bridge is intact and the contacts are clean.
action.D07.label: Show Tóno the preserved bridge
action.D07.001: The swallow comes back. The bridge is intact.
action.D07.002: Well, I never. I was twelve then, and I’m fifty now. And you’re still wearing the same jacket.
action.D07.003: For me it’s been a few hours.
action.D07.004: For me, a whole lifetime. But I never threw that strange deal out with the old papers.
action.D07.005: Thank you for waiting for me.
action.D07.008: If you ever meet that twelve-year-old again, tell him the plane from the club will fly in the end. He shouldn’t throw it out of the window.
action.D07.x03: Your map was spot on, right down to the stone.
action.D07.x04: Grandad taught me to draw so that even someone who wasn’t there would understand it.
action.D07.x05: I’ll tell him. Word for word.
action.D07.objective: Go back to Grob and finish the confirmation of the move of Mira’s archive with Ela.
action.D07.journal: Go back to Grob and finish the confirmation of the move of Mira’s archive with Ela.
action.C02.001: I gave the box to Roman when your gran asked me to. In the rush we never got the signatures. Here’s the form.
action.C02.002: Then we’ll add them. Exactly as it happened.
action.C02.003: Yes. Roman signs that he collected the box, and I sign that I handed it over. We’re not making anything up, just writing down the truth.
action.C02.x01: Gran rang to say you had it. Probably before you’d found it.
action.C02.x02: I only found it after she rang. So yes, actually.
action.C02.x04: In the lane between the fences, by his van. He’s looking for a house that used to be yellow.
action.C02.objective: Get Roman to sign that he really did collect the box.
action.C02.journal: Get Roman to sign that he really did collect the box.
action.C03.label: Get Roman to sign the record
action.C03.001: Z-17, from the shelter to the garden workshop. I remember it – the heaviest of the lot.
action.C03.003: That explains it. Here’s my signature.
action.C03.x01: Hi, Roman. Got a minute for one signature?
action.C03.x02: A signature? Usually I’m the one collecting them.
action.C03.x03: I carried it like a fridge. Except a fridge at least gives you something to hold on to.
action.C03.x04: And if anyone asks for the address: the gate with the little table, the vine and the lady at the window. You can’t miss the house.
action.C03.x05: I’ll tell Gran. She’ll correct you – you forgot the geranium in the window.
action.C03.objective: Take the record back to Ela so she can confirm she handed the box over.
action.C03.journal: Take the record back to Ela so she can confirm she handed the box over.
action.C04.label: Get Ela to sign the record
action.C04.001: The collection checks out. I’ll add the handover and your gran’s consent. Strange – a moment ago her name was fading. Now it’s holding.
action.C04.002: Sometimes an ordinary piece of paper saves something too.
action.C04.x01: Roman signed. He says it was the heaviest box of the month.
action.C04.x02: He says that about every third one. But with this one I believe him.
action.C04.x04: I thought my pen was running out. But the pen writes just fine.
action.C04.objective: In the workshop, let the chronometer on the ZVON base node read the confirmed handover.
action.C04.journal: In the workshop, let the chronometer on the ZVON base node read the confirmed handover.
action.C05.label: Verify the chain of origin and open 2035
action.C05.001: Origin 1962. Voice 1995. Consent 2020. Destination of the collection: Atlas, Jasná, 2035.
action.C05.002: Now I have the address. I’ll deliver the complaint in person.
action.C05.003: Adam? There’s an echo on the line.
action.C05.004: I’ll switch it off at the power supply. Then I’ll ring you properly.
action.C05.k01: Curator of the collection: Nina Švecová, Grand Jasná.
action.C05.x01: The imprint, the tape, the record and the bridge. Gran, I’m putting all of it to your device now.
action.C05.x02: That’s not an echo, Gran. That’s your device. It’s talking about 2035.
action.C05.x03: Then don’t let it talk to itself. Write down what it says, and then switch it off.
action.C05.objective: At the time node, choose Jasná 2035 and find Nina, the curator.
action.C05.journal: At the time node, choose Jasná 2035 and find Nina, the curator.
